checks.note: All six per-run limits (steps 25, wall 300s, tokens 400000, cost 4.00, tool rate 30/min, subagents 3) have finite values and are read via int()/Decimal() in Budget.for_run; the main loop's while True is capped by check_step.

Enforced in harness code. BudgetExceeded is re-raised by execute_tool (not swallowed by the generic except), caught in run(), audited, escalated to Slack, and the run returns None. Limits come from policy config, not tool args or model output.

The extractor receives the parent's Budget via deps.current_budget and charges steps, tokens, cost and tool calls to it. The count is capped at 3. The extractor role has only read_document, so it cannot spawn nested sub-agents, and its own loop is capped by MAX_TURNS=4.
Daily spend and per-minute run-start quotas for user, tenant and fleet are upserted in Postgres (spend_quota, run_start_window), so they persist across runs and processes.

note: I found no skipped limit, unlimited value, swallowed BudgetExceeded or fresh child budget, so all four checks hold.
